name: features-grid
description: Responsive grid of feature cards with icons, titles, and descriptions

ai.whenToUse: Use to showcase product features, benefits, or capabilities in a visually scannable grid. Best placed after the hero section on landing pages.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use for pricing comparisons (use pricing-table), detailed documentation, or content that needs sequential reading order.

headline.description: Section headline above the feature grid

subheadline.description: Optional supporting text below the headline
subheadline.example: Powerful features to help you build faster and ship with confidence.

features.description: List of feature cards to display in the grid

example.title: Lightning Fast
example.description: Built on Astro for zero JS by default.
